self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Inflorescence Unattainable: while using Aimed Shots, Charged Attack DMG +12% every 0.5s, stacking up to 6 times (max +72%); removed 10s after leaving Aiming Mode. Gliding stamina reduction is not damage-relevant and is not modeled. Select the stack count.

en.flavor: A longbow that burns like a flame. The feathers that adorn it are said to have come from the ancient tyrant Ngoubou.

refinements.1: Decreases Gliding Stamina consumption by 15%. When using Aimed Shots, the DMG dealt by Charged Attacks increases by <r>6%</r> every 0.5s. This effect can stack up to 6 times and will be removed 10s after leaving Aiming Mode.

fr.flavor: Un arc long qui brûle comme une flamme. Les plumes qui l'ornent proviendraient de l'ancien tyran Ngoubou.
